name: SSF
recent: SSF Home Group 于2026年10月26日宣布，其全资子公司 SSF Sdn. Bhd. 与 IFFCO Foods 签署有条件买卖协议，以 RM42,471,000 收购 Pulau Indah 的三块工业地，用于仓库扩张。公司将于2026年11月27日召开第四届常年股东大会。最新财报显示，2026财年末季营收与净利同比、环比均大幅下滑。
notable: 全资子公司 SSF Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM42,471,000 收购 Pulau Indah 三块工业地，用于仓库扩张。
董事经理兼首席执行官 Wong Choong Loong 在2026年11月16日以 RM2,660,000 增持 7,000,000 股普通股。
公司将于2026年11月27日召开第四届常年股东大会。
risks: 执行董事兼副首席执行官 Lok Kok Khong 于2026年11月13日表示有意在闭市期交易公司股份。
董事经理兼首席执行官 Wong Choong Loong 于2026年11月10日表示有意在闭市期交易公司股份。
最新季度营收环比下降56.2%，净利环比下降80.2%，同比分别下降49.7%和76.8%。

recent_en: SSF Home Group announced on 26 October 2026 that its wholly-owned subsidiary SSF Sdn. Bhd. signed a conditional sale and purchase agreement with IFFCO Foods to acquire three industrial land parcels in Pulau Indah for RM42,471,000 for warehouse expansion. The latest financial results show significant year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter declines in revenue and net profit for the final quarter of FY2026.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SSF Sdn. Bhd. is acquiring three industrial land parcels in Pulau Indah for RM42,471,000 for warehouse expansion.
Managing Director/CEO Wong Choong Loong acquired 7,000,000 ordinary shares for RM2,660,000 on 16 November 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director/Deputy CEO Lok Kok Khong indicated on 13 November 2026 an intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
Managing Director/CEO Wong Choong Loong indicated on 10 November 2026 an intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 56.2% QoQ and net profit fell 80.2% QoQ, with YoY declines of 49.7% and 76.8% respectively.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM25,645,000, down 56.2% QoQ and 49.7% YoY; net profit was RM1,363,000, down 80.2% QoQ and 76.8% YoY; net margin was 5.3% versus 11.8% in the previous quarter.
